newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Allied Domecq upped to "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Allied Domecq upped to "buy".

text.p: Shares in Allied Domecq Plc were higher in early afternoon after Kleinwort Benson upgraded the stock to "buy" from "hold".

"The disposal of Carlsberg-Tetley was cleverly crafted to be earnings enhancing. Allied now has the opportunity to make a retailing aquisition and even without that the shares are looking 10 percent cheap," said Kleinwort's Matthew Jordan.
By 1123 GMT Allied shares were up 8p at 461-1/2p.
Details of Bass's acquisition of Allied's 50 percent stake in Carlsberg-Tetley were announced at the weekend.
